const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "set -euo pipefail
manifest=.ai/task/repair-w6-20260922/PACK-MANIFEST.json
root=evidence/quality/repair-window-6-20260922
count=0
total=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r src rel want_sha want_bytes; do
  test -f "$src" || { echo "MISSING_SOURCE $src"; exit 20; }
  got_sha=$(sha256sum "$src" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  got_bytes=$(wc -c < "$src")
  test "$got_sha" = "$want_sha" || { echo "SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH $src"; exit 21; }
  test "$got_bytes" = "$want_bytes" || { echo "SOURCE_BYTES_MISMATCH $src"; exit 22; }
  dst="$root/orchestration/$rel"
  if test -e "$dst"; then
    cmp -s "$src" "$dst" || { echo "DEST_CONFLICT $dst"; exit 23; }
  fi
  count=$((count+1)); total=$((total+got_bytes))
done < <(jq -r '.files[] | [.source,.relative_destination,.sha256,(.bytes|tostring)] | @tsv' "$manifest")
manifest_dst="$root/orchestration-pack-manifest.json"
if test -e "$manifest_dst"; then cmp -s "$manifest" "$manifest_dst" || { echo "DEST_CONFLICT $manifest_dst"; exit 24; }; fi
catalog_src=.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window6-20260922-candidate-catalog
while IFS= read -r src; do
  rel=${src#"$catalog_src/"}; dst="$rel"
  if test -e "$dst"; then cmp -s "$src" "$dst" || { echo "DEST_CONFLICT $dst"; exit 25; }; fi
done < <(find "$catalog_src" -type f -print | sort)
migration_src=.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window6-20260922-migration.json
migration_dst=evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations/92da0238e3a17f7b5d3b4e46156ef0b9d5bacfd653bb2e00618d6f0ede25a83d.json
test -f "$migration_src"
if test -e "$migration_dst"; then cmp -s "$migration_src" "$migration_dst" || { echo "DEST_CONFLICT $migration_dst"; exit 26; }; fi
for name in PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md PACK-REPLAY-PROBE.json CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json HOST-AUDIT-COUNT-CORRECTION.json; do
  src=".ai/task/repair-w6-20260922/$name"; dst="$root/publication/$name"; test -f "$src"
  if test -e "$dst"; then cmp -s "$src" "$dst" || { echo "DEST_CONFLICT $dst"; exit 27; }; fi
done
for name in window6-20260922-queue-1.log window6-20260922-queue-1-timing.json window6-20260922-catalog.log window6-20260922-catalog-timing.json window6-20260922-migration.json window6-20260922-migration-timing.json window6-20260922-migration-run.log window6-20260922-migration-run-timing.json; do
  src=".artifacts/i18n/repair-window/$name"; dst="$root/publication/$name"; test -f "$src"
  if test -e "$dst"; then cmp -s "$src" "$dst" || { echo "DEST_CONFLICT $dst"; exit 28; }; fi
done
src=.artifacts/i18n/continuation-20260922/review252-push-verification.json; dst="$root/publication/review252-push-verification.json"; test -f "$src"
if test -e "$dst"; then cmp -s "$src" "$dst" || { echo "DEST_CONFLICT $dst"; exit 29; }; fi
printf 'PREFLIGHT_OK manifest_files=%s manifest_bytes=%s catalog_files=%s attachments=%s\n' "$count" "$total" "$(find "$catalog_src" -type f | wc -l)" 15",
  workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
  yield_time_ms: 10000,
  max_output_tokens: 4000
});
text(r.output);
